items.title: Isaiah "Ike" Robinson Interview, 1961-04-28
items.q: Yeah, but I think Punch only got that when he left here.

ctx.x: It's too bad Chris Kelly didn't and Buddy Petit, none of those fellows made records. Punch did and Armstrong and a lot of others.
